headline: German Industrial Output Rises 0.7% in September on Car Production
summary: Industrial output in Germany rose 0.7% in September from the previous month, beating expectations, led by car production and a rebound in pharmaceuticals.
why: German industrial production data serves as a key economic health indicator for Europe's largest economy and the broader eurozone manufacturing sector.

impacts.name: DAX Performance Index
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected industrial production points to resilience in German manufacturing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A surprise increase in industrial output, driven by car manufacturing, bolsters economic sentiment.
